Person 2 says: "Coming through on your right." (Person 2 is facing you: their left is your right, and their right is your left.) Which way do you move, left or right?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Left  
Because they will pass on your right, you move to your left to clear that side.
